description: Scheduled-chat automation workflows for the SZL Holdings platform

automations.title: Weekly Status Report
automations.prompt: Generate a weekly status report covering: (1) ecosystem health across all SZL Holdings platforms, (2) top alerts and resolved incidents from the past 7 days, (3) key operational metrics and trend deltas, (4) blockers and upcoming milestones. Format as an executive brief with a traffic-light status for each domain.
automations.alloyCommandPrompt: Run weekly-status-report workflow. Query lyte_health_check, vessels_fleet_status, firestorm_threat_scan, terra_market_signals, and inca_experiment_status. Synthesize into a structured brief. Deliver to #ops-weekly Slack channel and create a Notion page under 'Weekly Reports'.

automations.title: Release Preparation Checklist
automations.prompt: Prepare a release checklist for the upcoming deployment. Include: (1) all open PRs and their merge status, (2) failing CI/CD pipelines, (3) pending security scans, (4) database migration readiness, (5) rollback plan, and (6) stakeholder communication draft. Flag any blockers that require human approval.
automations.alloyCommandPrompt: Run release-prep workflow. Query GitHub Actions for CI status, check alloy_decision_status for approval_required items, run firestorm_compliance_check, and generate release notes artifact via alloy_create_artifact. Return a structured go/no-go recommendation.

automations.title: Incident Triage Protocol
automations.prompt: An incident has been triggered. Execute the SZL Holdings triage protocol: (1) identify the affected systems and blast radius, (2) pull recent error logs and anomaly signals, (3) check for related CVEs or known issues, (4) page the on-call team with a structured summary, (5) create a war-room Slack channel, and (6) draft a customer-facing status update.
automations.alloyCommandPrompt: Run incident-triage workflow with incident_id parameter. Query lyte_health_check for affected services, firestorm_threat_scan for related threats, send Slack message to #incidents, create PagerDuty incident if not already created, and generate incident brief via alloy_create_artifact.

automations.title: Code Quality Weekly Sweep
automations.prompt: Run a code quality sweep across all active repositories: (1) aggregate ESLint and TypeScript errors, (2) identify files with no test coverage above threshold, (3) flag stale dependencies with known vulnerabilities, (4) surface dead code candidates, and (5) generate a prioritized refactor ticket list for the next sprint.
automations.alloyCommandPrompt: Run code-quality-sweep workflow. Query GitHub for recent commits and open PRs, run biome lint summary, aggregate test coverage reports, and generate a code-health-report artifact. Create Linear issues for each critical finding with priority P2 or higher.

automations.title: Repository Maintenance Run
automations.prompt: Perform monthly repository maintenance: (1) identify and close stale issues (>90 days inactive), (2) archive completed milestones, (3) update CODEOWNERS and branch protection rules, (4) rotate expiring API keys flagged in the secrets registry, (5) prune merged feature branches, and (6) update dependency lockfiles.
automations.alloyCommandPrompt: Run repo-maintenance workflow. List stale GitHub issues via GitHub Actions, identify branches merged >30 days ago, query secrets rotation schedule from alloy_skill_invoke with skill 'secrets-audit', and generate maintenance summary artifact. Require admin approval before closing issues.

automations.title: Growth Signal Digest
automations.prompt: Compile today's growth signal digest: (1) new user registrations and activation rate delta, (2) MRR changes and churn signals, (3) feature adoption metrics for newly shipped features, (4) top support tickets by volume, and (5) competitor mentions from social listening. Format as a punchy 5-bullet executive brief.
automations.alloyCommandPrompt: Run growth-signals workflow. Query lyte_executive_summary for platform KPIs, pull Stripe subscription events, aggregate support queue metrics, and run perplexity_search for competitor mentions. Generate growth-digest artifact and post to #growth Slack channel.
